primaryLadderLane.name: Full System Dapp Entertainment Experience
primaryLadderLane.claim: DigitalHut competes as a compact 2026 media system: video search, video playback, sound, autoplay, next episode, previous episode, 3D Model View, podcast play, and live analytics in one dapp interface.
primaryLadderLane.whyThisIsStronger: The rank target is not a single niche like real estate, market, or developer proof. Those are category inputs. The real competition is the full entertainment compatibility loop that a long-time YouTube user expects when they want an alternative.

latestLiveRead.rankGuardrail: No real Google rank improvement claim until Search Console returns query/page/country rows, impressions, clicks, or average position.

skip.reason: Cannot compete with full media compatibility.
DigitalHut uses 3D as part of video/podcast/analytics, not only as an asset page.
DigitalHut podcast moments interrupt and return to the media story.
Market data is a contextual branch, not the main entertainment system.

compete.metric: autoplay, next/previous, search, sound, continuous episode compatibility
same-view video plus 3D rendering plus analytics
source/proof routes and useful analysis attached to the entertainment moment

metadata consistently describes the full compatibility loop
public proof packets avoid thin duplicate pages
